generators.carrier: F2-linear coboundary map on the 2x2 tetron torus

relations.statement: M(w)=d1 w for every cochain w
relations.hypotheses: definition of readout on the fixed 2x2 torus instance

relations.statement: For logical representatives wc (column) and wr (row): wc != wr and d1 wc = 0 = d1 wr
relations.hypotheses: explicit cochain data of the 2x2 tetron torus, checked by finite computation

lemmas.statement: There exist wc != wr with M(wc)=M(wr)=0, so M is not injective on these classes and is DETECTOR_INADEQUATE for them
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem inadequate (M : C1 -> C2) (wc wr : C1) (hne : wc ≠ wr) (hc : M wc = 0) (hr : M wr = 0) : M wc = M wr ∧ wc ≠ wr := ⟨hc.trans hr.symm, hne⟩

near_misses.claim: Syndrome d1 w alone distinguishes the column and row logical classes
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: both have d1 w = 0 yet they are distinct cochains

open_obligations: Explicit cochain vectors and d1 matrix for the 2x2 tetron torus not grounded
Distinctness of column and row representatives must be computed on the host
Not shown that the two are cohomologically distinct (non-trivial classes) rather than just distinct cochains
No existing declarations cited; Lean skeleton is abstract, not instance-specific
Adequacy of a syndrome-plus-class readout is not computed
